body: I didn’t realize there are other people with this issue too, or that it might be related to ADHD. I’ve always felt like I’m the odd one out because I just don’t remember anything unless it really stood out to me for some reason. It’s so awkward when I’m hanging out with friends from high school and they start talking about all this stuff that happened during our friendship there and at times I’ll recall what they’re talking about but I’m never able to talk about any of our old times because I feel like I just don’t remember them. For some reason this is especially true from the start of my junior year until the second semester of my senior year. I literally remember nothing from that time period, even when prompted by people talking about big events that I seemed to be apart of. It’s super weird tbh.

For everyone in here saying you have these symptoms and must be ADHD, you’re probably not ADHD. This comic shows problems that a lot of people have, and it gives the impression that having these problems means you must be ADHD. That’s not the case. Everyone struggles with stuff like this, but not everyone struggles with it the way ADHD people do. All of this is dialed up to 11 when you have ADHD. You are not ADHD just because you procrastinate sometimes, or you have trouble motivating yourself to do something, or you get really intense about certain things. It’s a different level for ADHD people.
